name: inventory-app
title: Inventory App — Physical-Capability Substrate
description: First-class scenario for tracking what the user physically owns — consumables, tools, assets — as ground truth for any lifestyle-bundle scenario that needs to know whether a given product / tool is available. Substrate for the routines-app gating (which routines are runnable now) and the gate for the lifestyle bundle's consumer-products and affiliate-commerce revenue lines. Non-mandatory, grows over time, designed to be useful even at partial coverage. Full vision and non-goals documented in the uploaded orchestration-summary.md.
